title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Ten University of Miami-listed activities with free admission or attendance; check each event page for registration and schedule updates.

cards.entity_name: CEPS William M. Hoeveler Ethics & Public Service Award Ceremony
cards.title: Attend the Hoeveler Award Ceremony
cards.subtitle: University of Miami School of Law · Oct. 29, 2026
cards.notes: Register through the University calendar, then attend the Center for Ethics and Public Service ceremony on the Coral Gables law campus.
cards.short_summary: A free campus ceremony recognizing public-service work.
cards.evidence_claim: The University calendar lists this Law Campus ceremony as a Free Event and asks attendees to register.
cards.source_title: CEPS William M. Hoeveler Ethics & Public Service Award Ceremony
cards.access_notes: Scheduled for Oct. 29, 2026 at 1311 Miller Rd. Registration is requested; confirm event details before going.

cards.entity_name: Latent Variable Modeling in the Behavioral Sciences | Yusuf Kara Lecture
cards.title: Hear the Yusuf Kara Lecture
cards.subtitle: Toll Library, Newman Alumni Center · Sept. 8, 2026
cards.notes: Register for the Institute for Data Science and Computing lecture, then bring a friend to Toll Library for the research discussion.
cards.short_summary: A free in-person talk about research methods in behavioral science.
cards.evidence_claim: The University calendar lists the Sept. 8 lecture at Newman Alumni Center's Toll Library as a Free Event.
cards.source_title: Latent Variable Modeling in the Behavioral Sciences | Yusuf Kara Lecture 9/8
cards.access_notes: Sept. 8, 2026, 4–6 p.m.; register through the event page. Location: 6200 San Amaro Dr.

cards.title: Explore AI Lawyering demos
cards.subtitle: Newman Alumni Center · Oct. 16, 2026
cards.notes: Reserve a place for the School of Law’s panels, hands-on workshops, and AI tool demonstrations at the Newman Alumni Center.
cards.short_summary: A free legal-tech conference with workshops and demonstrations.
cards.evidence_claim: The University calendar identifies this Oct. 16 conference at Newman Alumni Center as a Free Event.
cards.access_notes: Oct. 16, 2026, 9 a.m.–4 p.m.; space is limited and registration is required. 6200 San Amaro Dr.

cards.entity_name: CEPS Lunch & Learn: Election Law and Voting Rights
cards.title: Join the election-law panel
cards.subtitle: Law Campus, F109 · Sept. 10, 2026
cards.notes: Register for the Center for Ethics and Public Service panel and arrive at F109 ready to listen and ask informed questions.
cards.short_summary: A free student-facing discussion of election law and voting rights.
cards.evidence_claim: The University calendar labels this CEPS panel at Law Campus F109 a Free Event and lists students as its audience.
cards.source_title: CEPS Lunch & Learn: Election Law and Voting Rights
cards.access_notes: Sept. 10, 2026, 12:20–1:40 p.m.; registration is requested. Location: 1311 Miller Rd.

cards.title: Spend time at Law Family Weekend
cards.subtitle: University of Miami School of Law · Sept. 24–26, 2026
cards.notes: Register with the law school and use the weekend’s campus programs to reconnect with your student and meet their UM community.
cards.short_summary: A free law-campus family program; football tickets are optional.
cards.evidence_claim: The University calendar lists Law Family Weekend as a Free Event and notes that Hurricanes football tickets are optional to purchase.
cards.access_notes: Sept. 24–26, 2026 at 1311 Miller Rd. Registration closes Sept. 4; football tickets, if desired, cost extra.

cards.title: Drop into the MRED+U info session
cards.subtitle: Online · Sept. 1, 2026
cards.notes: Register for the School of Architecture’s virtual session to learn about the real-estate development and urbanism program and ask questions.
cards.short_summary: A free online University of Miami program-information session.
cards.evidence_claim: The University calendar lists the Sept. 1 MRED+U virtual information session as a Free Event.
cards.access_notes: Virtual session on Sept. 1, 2026; register through the event page for access details.

cards.title: Take the sensory tree tour and concert
cards.subtitle: Gifford Arboretum Stone Circle · April 16, 2026
cards.notes: Watch the University calendar for future Arboretum programming; this listing paired a sensory tree tour with a free outdoor concert.
cards.short_summary: A University-listed free Arboretum tour and Frost music performance.
cards.evidence_claim: The University listed the 2026 Arbor Day celebration as a Free Event, including a Gifford Arboretum sensory tour and free concert.
cards.access_notes: This listed event occurred April 16, 2026 at the Arboretum Stone Circle, Cox Science Building; it is included as documented free programming, not a standing daily activity.

cards.entity_name: Green U Tour of the Coral Gables Campus
cards.title: Follow a Green U campus tour
cards.subtitle: Starts at Stanford Circle · July 7, 2026
cards.notes: Use this route as a prompt to seek future Green U tours, which visit sustainability sites including gardens, restoration work, and murals.
cards.short_summary: A documented free tour of named sustainability sites on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The University listed the July 2026 Green U Coral Gables campus tour as a Free Event.
cards.source_title: Green U tour of the Coral Gables campus
cards.access_notes: This listed tour occurred July 7, 2026 and began at the Admission Office lobby, 1306 Stanford Dr.; look for a newly posted session.

cards.title: Help in the Sustainability Garden
cards.subtitle: Gifford Arboretum · July 2, 2026
cards.notes: Look for the next maintenance hour and bring a hat, tied shoes, and water bottle to help care for plots in the Sustainability Garden.
cards.short_summary: A documented free volunteer hour for hands-on campus garden care.
cards.evidence_claim: The University listed Garden Volunteering Hour as a Free Event for UM community members in the Gifford Arboretum Sustainability Garden.
cards.access_notes: The cited monthly maintenance session occurred July 2, 2026. The listing welcomes UM community volunteers; verify the next date before visiting.

cards.title: Catch a Frost Horns performance
cards.subtitle: Newman Recital Hall · March 5, 2026
cards.notes: Monitor Frost’s calendar for the next Horns & Friends program, then meet at Newman Recital Hall for the ensemble’s mixed-genre set.
cards.short_summary: A documented free Frost School concert featuring horn music.
cards.evidence_claim: The University listed Frost Horns & Friends at Newman Recital Hall as FREE.
cards.access_notes: The cited performance occurred March 5, 2026 at 5513 San Amaro Dr.; confirm a future program date before making plans.

warnings: Four cards document past 2026 University events and direct readers to confirm a future recurrence; the remaining six are scheduled for September or October 2026. Registration or RSVP may be required even where attendance is free.
